issues.on_page: Crossed-out pages 2, 4, 6: General ending 106,509 vs 65,093; transfers 46,366 vs 62,910; General Government 42,514 vs 41,130; Water 26,653 vs 28,037; Municipal Equalization in General column instead of Street
issues.issue: The extractor rightly used the unmarked pages, but it put the void versions' differing figures only in notes. By analogy with the budget-form rule, they belong in report_discrepancies with a review note.
The county treasurer balance is printed outside the fund totals and isn't recorded. It may be cash the village holds at the county.
Governmental 'other' is 24,111 of 119,565 (20%, above 10%). No breakdown is printed, so it's defensible, but it goes to review.
Principal and interest on the USDA loan are combined and not split. Marked review.
